parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'totals', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'quotes_total',   count(*),
    'quotes_30d',     count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'),
    'pending',        count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'requested'),
    'quoted',         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'quoted'),
    'accepted',       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'accepted'),
    'rejected',       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('rejected_by_us','rejected_by_supplier','expired','withdrawn'))
  ) FROM trade_quotes),
  'by_trade', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.quotes_total DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT
      coalesce(trade_type, 'sin_categoria') AS trade_type,
      count(*)::int AS quotes_total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'quoted')::int AS quoted,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'accepted')::int AS accepted,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'requested' AND request_sent_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days')::int AS stale,
      round(coalesce(avg(amount) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), 0)::numeric, 0) AS avg_amount,
      max(created_at) AS last_quote_at,
      count(DISTINCT supplier_email)::int AS unique_suppliers
    FROM trade_quotes
    GROUP BY coalesce(trade_type, 'sin_categoria')
  ) t),
  'top_suppliers', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.quotes_total DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT supplier_name, supplier_email, count(*)::int AS quotes_total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'accepted')::int AS accepted,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'quoted')::int AS quoted,
      max(created_at) AS last_contact_at,
      round(coalesce(avg(amount) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), 0)::numeric, 0) AS avg_amount
    FROM trade_quotes
    GROUP BY supplier_name, supplier_email
    ORDER BY count(*) DESC
    LIMIT 15
  ) t),
  'stale_pending', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.days_waiting DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT supplier_name, supplier_email, trade_type,
      coalesce(request_sent_at, created_at) AS sent_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - coalesce(request_sent_at, created_at)))/86400)::int AS days_waiting,
      project_id::text AS project_id
    FROM trade_quotes
    WHERE status = 'requested'
      AND coalesce(request_sent_at, created_at) < now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
    LIMIT 10
  ) t)
) AS report;
